concept: Full-body 3D character render of Slender Man, an extremely tall and thin faceless humanoid with a blank smooth featureless white head, wearing a black business suit, white shirt and black tie, with unnaturally long thin arms and several long black tentacles growing from its upper back. Rig-ready A-pose: its long arms are held clearly away from its body at about forty-five degrees, with a visible gap between each arm and the torso, not touching the suit; its legs are slightly apart; the tentacles spread out wide behind and around it, separated from each other, from the arms and from the head, none crossing the body. Seen strictly from the front: it faces the camera straight on. One single creature, centered, the whole body visible. Plain uniform light grey studio background, no floor, no ground, no pedestal, no cast shadow, soft even studio lighting.
desc_courte: Slender Man, extremely tall and thin faceless humanoid, blank smooth white head, black business suit with tie, unnaturally long thin arms, several long black tentacles from its back
